resources.string: Netology. University of Internet Professions of the Future

Hi! This is the new Netology. It started with intensives in online marketing and later grew to include courses in design, development, analytics and management. We grow and help our students grow from beginners into confident professionals. But the most important thing stays with us: we believe everyone already has the power that makes them want more, aim higher and run faster. Our mission is to help set off on the path of growth and start a chain of changes → http://netolo.gy/fyb
